implementation_notes: ContextPacket is JSON/readonly with fixed instruction, state, evidence, content partitions and source_refs.
Only a U04-approved loader snapshot supplies identity, voice, values, boundaries and examples to instruction.

Dynamic input is first captured once from own property descriptors into a bounded detached snapshot, then exact shapes, strict JSON values, source_refs, scope, version, depth and byte limits are validated before deep-freezing.

Accessors, hidden or symbol fields, sparse arrays, and non-finite numbers are rejected; ordinary Proxy get traps are not invoked, while reflection traps may run, so the implementation is not a same-process sandbox.
Canon is explicitly labeled fictional-character-canon in state; tool results and trusted facts remain evidence; user, external and memory values remain content.
Canonical JSON fixes partition order and sorts nested object keys. Builder-local WeakSet/WeakMap provenance rejects copied or deserialized packets; restore by rebuilding from approved role and data.
Budget checks complete rendered JSON UTF-8 bytes against max_tokens using utf8-byte-upper-bound; it excludes native system/project rules and is not a model tokenizer count.

considered_sources.decision: Inspected during implementation. The pre-review candidate reused isJsonValue then reread input values; review reproduced a descriptor/get-trap time-of-check/time-of-use issue. Final U05 uses a single descriptor snapshot and does not call this validator.
Three reproduced Proxy get-trap findings are preserved with the pre-repair manifest and code diff; attempt-4 covers the fix.
